hints.displayName: Optional human-friendly label shown in the dashboard only. Falls back to the model name when unset.
hints.modelName: Engine-agnostic API identifier clients send in the model field of OpenAI requests. Must be unique across the cluster.
hints.servedModelName: Model identity the engine reports in metrics and responses. Defaults to the model name.
hints.modelPath: Absolute path to model weights on shared storage.
hints.requiredMemory: Estimated device memory in GiB. Used for placement.
hints.deviceType: Required device type. Leave blank to accept any compatible device.
hints.tensorParallel: Number of devices to split the model across on a single worker.
hints.runtimeModule: Installed SIF the worker execs (→ /modules/<name>.sif), filtered to the selected runner.
hints.runtimeModuleNone: No runtime modules for this runner are installed. Import one from the Runner Catalog to deploy.
hints.pinned: Pinned models cannot be evicted by the LRU eviction engine.
hints.engineConfig: Optional engine-specific configuration. Must be valid JSON if provided.
hints.engineArgs: One engine CLI flag per line (--flag=value, --flag value, or --flag). Passed verbatim to the engine. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
hints.runnerTypeFallback: No worker capabilities are available yet — showing default runner types. The list will update once workers come online.

validation.servedModelNamePattern: Served model name may only contain letters, digits, and . _ / - (max 200 characters).
validation.requiredMemoryPositive: Required memory must be a positive number.
validation.tensorParallelMin: Tensor parallelism must be at least 1.
validation.runtimeModuleRequired: Runtime module is required. Import one from the Runner Catalog if the list is empty.
validation.runtimeModulePattern: Runtime module may only contain letters, digits, and . _ - (e.g. vllm-0.21).
validation.engineConfigObject: Engine config must be a JSON object.
validation.engineConfigValidJson: Engine config must be valid JSON.
validation.engineArgsReserved: {{flag}} is reserved and set by the platform — remove it.
validation.engineArgsAbbreviatesReserved: {{flag}} is an ambiguous abbreviation of the reserved flag {{reserved}} — remove it.
